name: San Cristóbal de las Casas
tagline: Highland colonial town and Maya villages of Chiapas
summary: San Cristóbal is a cool highland colonial town in Chiapas, ringed by Tzotzil and Tzeltal Maya villages. Walk its pedestrian streets and markets, visit the church of San Juan Chamula where Maya rituals blend with Catholicism, take a boat through the towering Sumidero Canyon, and travel on to the jungle ruins of Palenque and the Agua Azul cascades.
seasonNote: Dry November to April; nights are cold at 2,200 m.
arrival: Fly to Tuxtla Gutiérrez, then 1 hour by road.
gettingAround: Walk; colectivos to villages; tours to Sumidero and Palenque.
cashTip: Carry pesos for markets and colectivos; cards work in larger places. Tip 10 to 15 percent.
foodTip: Tamales chiapanecos, sopa de pan, local coffee and pox (corn liquor).
